assessments.summary: This is a strong, publishable Spanish adaptation. All three edits are defensible. The most useful one restores the wayfinding sense of 'navigate' ('orientarnos'), which is needed for the contrast with 'viajeros perdidos'. The other two are optional polish. The only remaining translation note is an optional severity-1 improvement to the human/inhuman echo. The inherited English issues (the CliffsNotes date, the unattributed quote, the unsupported map-reading statistic, the loose footnote wording) are listed only under sourceConcerns.
